name: Pika Pika no Mi
description: (Tag:light)(Tag:meta)(Tag:transformation)The Pika Pika no Mi is an awful-tasting Devil Fruit granting the ability [Light Logia](Divine). The first to digest any part gains the ability and renders the rest inert, but gains the Curse of the Sea: unable to use energy when submerged in still water with rapidly draining stamina. Stacking two Curses of the Sea on one person kills them instantly.
